cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Western US changed by +0.036 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.001 to +0.069), which is statistically significant (p = 0.05). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.089 mm/day.

ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in the Western US shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.09): the estimate is −0.41 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −0.89 to +0.07). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
